exposure: Presence or absence of Caesarean Section scar
outcome: Histological changes at the CS scar site
cohort: 52 consecutive benign hysterectomy specimens (22 with CS scar, 30 without)
finding: The study did not find a significant association between having a Caesarean Section scar and myometrial hypertrophy, suggesting that CS scar alone may not be the cause of adverse gynaecological symptoms.
